description: Compare an existing home loan rate against a lower one and estimate the monthly and whole-of-term saving. Use this when someone asks whether refinancing is worth it, or what dropping their rate would save them. Call it rather than multiplying the balance by the rate gap: that shortcut ignores the principal in a P&I repayment and overstates the saving. Both rates are arguments — this tool does not quote or assume a market rate.

currentRate.description: The rate they're on now, as a percentage, e.g. 6.8.

newRate.description: The rate being compared against, as a percentage, e.g. 6.2.

termYears.description: Years remaining on the loan. Defaults to 30.

name: estimate_refinance_savings

currentRepayment.description: Monthly repayment at the current rate, AUD.

monthlySaving.description: Monthly difference, AUD. Zero if the new rate is higher.

newRepayment.description: Monthly repayment at the new rate, AUD.

totalSaving.description: Saving over the full remaining term, AUD.

title: Estimate refinance savings
